new.n: Beaver Dam camp, sec. 6 T52N R35W (1911 plat)
new.pl: SE SE sec. 6 T52N R35W, on the Log Road, Houghton County
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T52N R35W page) marks a camp on the Log Road in SE SE sec. 6, with "Beaver Dam" labelled on the creek in NW sec. 6. A log road runs on through secs. 5, 8, 17 and 20.
new.t: Look for the camp clearing, stove parts, bottles and horseshoes. Ask the landowner or the forest office first.
src: Plat book of Houghton County, Michigan (Weston & Hancock, c1911), T52N R35W page (scan 44) (Neb's screenshot)
pinev: Placed at the centre of SE SE sec. 6; good to about 250 m

new.n: Dam on the Nisula road, sec. 19 T51N R35W (1911 plat)
new.pl: NW SW sec. 19 T51N R35W, where a road crosses the stream, Houghton County
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T51N R35W page) prints "Dam" on the stream in the west part of sec. 19, about NW SW, where a road crosses it, between Nisula and Alston. It was most likely a logging or mill dam.
new.t: Look for the dam crib timbers, the old pond flat and any mill or camp site beside it. Ask the landowner first.
src: Plat book of Houghton County, Michigan (Weston & Hancock, c1911), T51N R35W page (scans 42-43) (Neb's screenshot)
pinev: Placed at the centre of NW SW sec. 19; good to about 250 m

new.v: Coins, tokens, railroad buttons and lantern parts, spikes, bottles
new.st: The 1911 Houghton County plat book (T51N R35W page) draws Pearce as a station circle on the Duluth, South Shore and Atlantic railway in the south part of sec. 27. It was a flag stop that is gone today.
new.t: Look for the depot or platform pad beside the old grade, coal and cinder spots, and the section-house site. Ask the landowner first, and keep off any active track.
